title: BLOCK HUNTER
objective_collect_gems_and_survive: Collect gems and survive the hazards.
objective_collect_gems_and_escape: Collect gems, find a key, and reach the exit.
story:
In the deep underground labyrinths,
 the block hunter seeks precious gems
 and dodges unstoppable boulders.
 Will you survive and become the best?
obj_dynamite: Dynamite — projectile: damages objects and triggers explosions.
obj_stone: Boulder — rolling obstacle that can crush you.
obj_door: Door — may require a key to open.
obj_gem: Gem — collectible that increases your score.
obj_ghost: Ghost — enemy that can harm the player.
obj_wooden: Wooden plank — consumable used to cover holes.
obj_hole1: Hole — a pit in the ground; can be covered with a plank.
obj_hole2: Hole (variant) — behaves like a regular hole.
obj_bat: Bat — flying enemy (watch when collecting gems).
